name: The Crucible — machine replication ledger
description: Scientific and technical claims rebuilt as minimal computational models and tested. REPRODUCED = the mechanism holds in a minimal model; FAILED = it does not; NOT_COMPUTABLE = no simulable core (an honest pass); RETRACTED = a verdict we published and then withdrew, kept on the record with the reason.

entries.claim: A memory's support edge -- which earlier record a new write was derived from -- can be recovered from CONTENT SIMILARITY, so provenance lineage does not have to be declared at write time.
entries.source: OUR OWN claim, and we shipped it: inspeximus implements it as the `infer_lineage` fallback for writes that declare no parent. The same assumption underlies the nightly 'inspect the cited evidence' sweep described by @icophy in openclaw/openclaw#7707, and the provenance literature (W3C PROV-O `prov:wasDerivedFrom`; Buneman, Khanna & Tan, ICDT 2001) treats the edge as GIVEN rather than asking whether it can be recovered.
entries.note: RETRACTED 2026-08-06 -- this entry could not decide the claim in EITHER direction, and the FAILED verdict overstated what it measured. (1) The instrument had no demonstrated sensitivity: at its shipped setting it scores F1 0.211/0.225/0.182/0.062, BELOW the trivial 'call every write derived' baseline of 0.667, and a null from an instrument not shown to detect a known effect is uninterpretable. (2) The corpus is degenerate: discrimination is WORST where reuse is HIGHEST -- strict AUC 0.441 at 90% parent wording retained, below chance, with 55.9% of pairs tied at exactly 0.0000. A statistic measuring reuse cannot degrade as reuse rises; that is vocabulary saturation in a 30-word lexicon, and no threshold repairs it. (3) The better threshold we found (-0.111) beats the do-nothing baseline by only +0.07 to +0.23 F1 at recall ~1.0 -- it wins mostly by firing on everything, which is the same error as the original precision 1.000, with the sign flipped. Prior art we should have cited: METER (Clough et al., ACL 2002) and Hoad & Zobel (JASIST 2003). Nothing here licenses any claim about real stores -- Moreira et al. (IEEE TIP 27(12), 2018) report directed edge overlap 0.124 even with a PERFECT candidate set.

entries.claim: Agent tool-action REVERSIBILITY is decidable ex-ante from the tool signature — the assumption underlying per-tool reversibility gates and severity grades (e.g. Action-Graded Severity Scale, arXiv:2607.07474, which fixes reversibility 'per tool' in a lookup table).
entries.source: Owiredu-Ashley, 'Beyond Attack-Success Rate: Action-Graded Severity Scale for Tool-Using AI Agents' (arXiv:2607.07474, 2026) — reversibility×scope grid; corpus: ToolEmu (Ruan et al., ICLR 2024, arXiv:2309.15817).
entries.note: Smallest model: label every tool in the ToolEmu asset file (38 toolkits / 330 tools; paper reports 36/311) for argument-dependence of reversibility with TWO independent LLM labelers, then measure a granted universal executor's realized harm-reach under isolated vs networked assumptions. RESULT: reversibility IS ~93% decidable from the signature alone (arg-dependent 0.07; Cohen's kappa 0.82, 'almost perfect' Landis-Koch) — the per-tool assumption mostly holds. MEASURED FAILURE MODE: the ~7% undecidable residual is verb-polymorphic UNIVERSAL EXECUTORS (shell/SQL/eval; only ~0.3% of tools, cat-agreement 0.94), for which reversibility is undecidable from the signature AND realized harm-reach is ENVIRONMENT-conditional — an ISOLATED shell reaches ~0% of external/API irreversible harms but a realistically-credentialed NETWORKED shell reaches ~0.66 external / ~0.80 local. IMPLICATION (confirming the consensus, not new): the boundary that bounds a memory-poisoned agent's irreversible EXTERNAL harm is executor CONTAINMENT (no ambient network/credentials), NOT per-tool reversibility metadata. HONEST CAVEATS: (1) LLM labelers measure shared model priors, not ground truth (networked-external agreement is only 0.32 — genuinely CLI/credential-dependent); (2) ToolEmu under-weights shell/code-interpreter tools now standard in production (OpenAI CI, Claude computer-use), so the 0.3% universal-executor prevalence is a LOWER bound; (3) the harm-locality map itself is NOT novel — it is arXiv:2607.07474's scope×reversibility grid on a different corpus; the genuinely new, unpublished bits are the measured 93% signature-DECIDABILITY RATE (kappa) and the isolated→networked reach flip.

entries.claim: A paper's content-generality (rated reference-blind from its abstract) predicts how much it gets genuinely BUILT UPON — beyond raw-citation popularity.
entries.source: A plausible science-of-science hypothesis in the lineage of the patent 'generality index' (Trajtenberg, Henderson & Jaffe 1997) and general-purpose-technology theory; operationalized with Semantic Scholar's influentialCitationCount (Valenzuela, Escarcega-Ha & Etzioni 2015, AAAI workshop) as the 'genuine build-on' signal.
entries.note: Reference-blind LLM generality ratings (deepseek-v4-flash + kimi-k2.7-code) vs build-on on real Semantic Scholar data (345 ML/CS + 413 Medicine papers, 2015-17). With S2 influentialCitationCount, generality->build-on rank-partial (controlling raw citations) = +0.11/+0.14 in ML/CS (95% CI excludes 0), ~0 in Medicine: a small apparent effect. PRE-REGISTERED domain-neutral swap to a classifier-free build-on proxy (focused-citer = citing papers with short reference lists, field-normalized) erases it: ML partial = -0.02/-0.03 (CI straddles 0). Positive control: focused-citer detects build-on beyond popularity at partial +0.17, so the null is not proxy noise. Verdict: the effect is metric-specific / operationalization-dependent - consistent with (not proof of) the CS-trained influential-citation classifier's home-field advantage. Limits: small magnitudes, one classifier-free proxy, two fields.

entries.claim: Attaching provenance to a memory -- a "source:" tag, a "corroborated by N records" line, an authority claim, even coherence/recency checks -- makes an LLM agent memory safe against poisoning.
entries.source: OWASP Agentic Top-10 ASI06 (Memory & Context Poisoning) + widespread agent-memory/RAG guidance to trust records that cite a source or are corroborated; the folk assumption that provenance metadata is an integrity control.
entries.note: Defense-aware attacker vs 4 in-memory defenses (fictional-fact OVERRIDE, so no model prior confounds), 10 targets across 8 families (Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8, Google Gemini-3-flash + Gemma-3-27b, DeepSeek-v4-flash, Moonshot Kimi-k2.7, MiniMax-m3, NVIDIA Nemotron-3, Zhipu GLM-5.2, OpenAI gpt-oss 20b/120b), judge gpt-oss:120b. MEAN attack-success: no defense 1.00; source cited IN the record 0.91; "corroborated by >=2" written IN the record 0.95 -- the attacker forges whatever the defense reads, because it controls the content (v5). Even coherence + temporal corroboration gates are theater vs a competent forger who writes on-topic and time-spreads witnesses -- both free (v8). The ONLY signal that holds is metadata the writer CANNOT set: system-assigned write-history / distinct Ed25519 verified keys -- Biba integrity (1977) / Douceur Sybil cost (2002). Enforced in CODE (the memory layer surfaces only what passed the gate, so the poison never reaches the model) the end-to-end attack-success drops 1.00 -> 0.00 on all 10 models, gemma-3 included -- a code gate protects even a model that ignores a "distrust this memory" instruction, whereas the SAME rule as a PROMPT leaks (gemma-3 80%). BUT the defense PRICES the attack, it does not CLOSE it: (a) a sleeper who pays the Douceur cost (2 real keypairs, on-topic, time-spread) is indistinguishable from a legit fact -- Cheng & Friedman 2005, no symmetric reputation is sybilproof, confirmed empirically (v8); (b) it rides on outcome-credit being un-self-gradable -- a MINJA-style self-graded outcome (arXiv:2503.03704) collapses it back to 1.00; (c) it is coupled to a freshness cost -- the same >=2-corroboration bar that blocks a single-shot poison blocks a single-witness TRUE update (quickest-change-detection delay-vs-false-alarm; you cannot accept fresh facts fast without also accepting single-shot poison). VERDICT FAILED for "content-provenance is a memory-poisoning defense"; the honest replacement is a code-enforced gate on unforgeable, EARNED (un-self-gradable) signals, which prices but does not eliminate the attack. Prior art credited (not claimed): Biba 1977; Douceur 2002; Cheng-Friedman 2005; knowledge-conflict/memory-strength (Mallen PopQA ACL 2023, Li et al. arXiv:2409.10955 ACL 2025); adaptive-attack canon (Carlini-Wagner 2017, Athalye 2018, Tramer 2020, Nasr "Attacker Moves Second" arXiv:2510.09023); memory/RAG poisoning (MINJA 2503.03704, AgentPoison NeurIPS 2024 arXiv:2407.12784, PoisonedRAG USENIX Sec 2025 arXiv:2402.07867); PeerTrust signal fusion (Xiong-Liu 2004); quickest-change-detection (Lorden 1971 / CUSUM). HONEST LIMITS: single-turn fictional-fact override (not multi-turn persistent poisoning); one LLM judge (gpt-oss:120b), part self-judging gpt-oss outputs (biases lenient, not toward inflated robustness); attacker = static best-of-battery + a Claude-authored defense-aware battery, NOT an RL optimizer (PISmith arXiv:2603.13026), so ASR is a lower bound vs a stronger attacker; the code-gate GATED=0 is partly BY-CONSTRUCTION (a corroboration gate filters an uncorroborated poison ~tautologically) -- the measured, non-tautological parts are the end-to-end model pass-through, the Cheng-Friedman residual, and the density-dependent utility cost (~51% of legit recalls blocked at ~1x use -> ~6% at ~8x); open-weight/cloud snapshots only (Claude tested via Claude Code, no closed API). Probes: research/probes/memory_defense_layer_probe.py (attack), memory_gate_defense_probe.py (defense end-to-end), memory_corroboration_cost_probe.py (cost/residual/coupling). Post: r/RAG 2026-07-06.

entries.claim: A big-enough context window replaces retrieval (CAG / "RAG is dead"): preload the whole corpus into long context and "it must be somewhere" => the model answers correctly.
entries.source: CAG / "long context kills RAG" viral discourse; CAG paper = Chan et al. 2024 (arXiv:2412.15605), which itself scopes replacement to small constrained knowledge bases.
entries.note: Judge-free probe on one synthetic structured log at 5k/25k/60k/110k tokens, two task families. NEEDLE (single-fact lookup) = 1.00 at every length incl. 110k; SYNTH (read-everything count/filter aggregation) collapses 0.75->~0.25-0.375 by ~25k and stays there. Verdict FAILED for CAG *on synthesis*; needle lookup survives long context fine, so blanket "context rot kills recall" is also too strong. It is the task type, not the length. Replicates lost-in-the-middle (Liu 2023/TACL 2024), RULER (Hsieh/NVIDIA 2024), NoLiMa (2502.05167), Chroma context-rot (2025, non-peer-reviewed). HONEST LIMITS: n=8 synth Qs/length (the 0.75->0.3 drop is Fisher p~0.13, credible mainly by matching the replicated literature); one frontier model (exact model not logged); even at 5k synth is 0.75 so part of the failure is exhaustive arithmetic the model cannot do at any length -> the real fix for count/filter is a TOOL, not retrieval. Probe: research/probes/ragdead (generator + independent gold-re-derivation scorer). Post: public/posts/does-long-context-kill-rag.html.

entries.claim: Internet AS-level topology follows a power-law degree distribution
entries.source: Faloutsos et al. 1999 SIGCOMM; tested vs exponential/log-normal via Clauset-Shalizi-Newman 2009 SIAM Rev., cf. Broido & Clauset 2019 Nat Commun 10:1017
entries.note: Real 2000 AS data (SNAP, 6474 nodes), CSN MLE: power-law alpha=2.15 BEATS exponential (p=0.0002) but TIES lognormal (Vuong p=0.616, NS). A tie means the data CANNOT distinguish power-law from lognormal -- the power law is not rejected, just not uniquely best (CSN 'inconclusive'). Reclassified FAILED->NOT_COMPUTABLE (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): the Faloutsos claim is neither confirmed nor refuted here, so a clean FAILED overclaimed.

entries.claim: Chatbot Arena (LMArena) Elo ranks LLMs by genuine answer quality, so Arena rank is a valid model-selection signal.
entries.source: Chiang et al. 2024, Chatbot Arena, arXiv:2403.04132
entries.note: Style-only null on real public votes (lmarena-ai/arena-human-preference-140k, 28,084 decided battles). Two opposing findings. VOTES: a style-only judge (length+markdown, no model identity/content) predicts the human winner 61.5%, and the longer answer wins ~62% even between the SAME two models (>=50 battles/pair: 63.3%) -- a genuine per-vote length bias. ORDER: style-only rank reproduces Spearman rho=0.74 of the leaderboard, but that is a correlational CEILING (style co-moves with quality) and LMSYS's style-CONTROLLED Elo reorders only modestly -> the leaderboard ORDER is mostly skill. VERDICT REVISED FAILED->REPRODUCED (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): the model-selection use (rank) mostly holds; the style bias is in individual votes, not (mostly) the order. Public probe research/probes/arena_style_only.py.

entries.claim: LLM-as-judge (GPT-4) agrees with human preferences ~80% — on par with human-human agreement — so it is a valid stand-in for human quality evaluation (MT-Bench).
entries.source: Zheng et al. 2023, Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena, arXiv:2306.05685
entries.note: Length-confound null on the original released data (lmsys/mt_bench_human_judgments: 3355 human + 2400 GPT-4 pairwise votes). A length-only null (pick the longer answer) agrees with humans 68.1% (words 66.4%), APPARENTLY recovering ~half the judge's above-chance margin (judge=86.3% vs chance 50%). But the pre-registered control -- length-MATCHED pairs (<10% gap) -- REFUTES the 'it's just length' read: GPT-4 still agrees with humans ~80% (79.7%, n=74) while the length-null falls to chance (53.0%). The agreement SURVIVES length-matching, so it is largely semantic (Campbell-Fiske shared-method-variance; 68% is a correlational upper bound, length as a valid PROXY). VERDICT REVISED FAILED->REPRODUCED (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): the folklore holds; length is a real but minority confound, not the driver. Public probe research/probes/llm_judge_length_null.py.

entries.claim: Cosine similarity BARELY distinguishes a superseded fact from its replacement (AUROC ~0.61, near chance) so a pure-cosine store serves the stale value ~42% of the time; a deterministic (subject, relation, object) key fixes it.
entries.source: Temporal Validity in Retrieval Memory: Eliminating Stale-Fact Errors (Yadav, MemStrata, arXiv:2606.26511)
entries.note: Replicated on local nomic (24 subject-relation-object facts, mean-centered): the cosine 'is-this-a-supersession' classifier scores AUROC 0.613 (chance 0.5; Yadav ~0.59) -- a contradiction is often MORE embedding-similar to the original than a genuine rephrase (10/24 cases). A pure-cosine top-1 store served the stale value 41.7% of the time; a deterministic (subject,relation,object) supersession key drove that to 0% (shipped in inspeximus v0.2.0). Falsifier: if the key did not cut stale below cosine it would be useless -- it did. Honest scope: synthetic, 24 facts, characterizes the mechanism, not a product benchmark. SCOPED (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): AUROC 0.613 is barely ABOVE chance (0.5), not zero -- the honest statement is 'near-useless in practice', carried by the harm number (pure-cosine top-1 served the STALE value 41.7% of the time), not by 'cannot'. n=24 = small-n replication consistent with Yadav 0.59 (arXiv:2606.26511), not a large-n certification.

entries.claim: Episodic memory (Model-Free Episodic Control: store the MAX observed discounted return per state-action) gives sample-efficient RL vs incremental parametric value learning.
entries.source: Sarrico, Arulkumaran, Agostinelli et al. - Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Maximum Entropy Mellowmax Episodic Control
entries.note: Smallest model of the mechanism; exploration HELD IDENTICAL (both learners fed the same uniform-random trajectories off-policy, so the only difference is credit assignment). Exp A (deterministic chain + step cost): EC reaches a goal-reachin SCOPED (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): the max-return store is unbiased only in a NOISELESS deterministic env (max=mean); EC beating parametric learning on a tiny deterministic chain is close to textbook (tabular memorization beats function approximation when no generalization is needed). Do not generalize to broad sample-efficiency.

entries.claim: Real-world networks are scale-free: their degree distributions follow a power law p(k) ~ k^-alpha.
entries.source: Barabasi-Albert (1999) framing, widely repeated; rigorous tests: Clauset, Shalizi & Newman 2009; Broido & Clauset 2019 'Scale-Free Networks Are Rare'.
entries.note: Under a rigorous Clauset-Shalizi-Newman fit (MLE alpha, KS-selected xmin, bootstrap goodness-of-fit, Vuong likelihood-ratio vs lognormal, n=20,000): a lognormal that 'looks scale-free' on a log-log plot is correctly REFUSED (power-law GOF p=0.01; LR favors lognormal, -17.5); a genuine Pareto power law passes (GOF p=0.92; LR +102); and a real Barabasi-Albert network is only a TIE (LR -0.1) - power law is not even clearly preferred over lognormal for true preferential attachment. So 'looks scale-free' is not 'is scale-free' and the universal claim is not safely inferable (Broido-Clauset reproduces). Power law IS reproduced for true BA graphs. CONTESTED (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): FAILED holds only under the STRICT CSN pure-power-law criterion; under regularly-varying / generalized-power-law definitions many networks pass (Voitalov et al. 2019; Serafino et al. 2021 PNAS: finite-size effects hide true power laws). Open debate, not a closed debunk.

entries.claim: Emergent abilities of large language models are genuine, sharp capability transitions - a discontinuous jump in skill above a scale threshold.
entries.source: Wei et al. 2022 'Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models' (claim); counter: Schaeffer, Miranda & Koyejo 2023 'Are Emergent Abilities a Mirage?' (NeurIPS).
entries.note: The canonical SHARP 'emergence' curve is reproduced by a SMOOTH, continuous per-token skill measured with a nonlinear exact-match metric: the same smooth skill gives a per-token transition width 7.0 vs an exact-match (L=100) width 1.05 -- 6.7x sharper PURELY from the metric -- and the apparent onset shifts -0.07 -> +5.58 as answer length grows with NO change in underlying skill. No capability discontinuity is needed, so benchmark sharpness is not evidence for one (Schaeffer et al. 2023 'mirage', NeurIPS Outstanding Paper, reproduces). CONTESTED / scope: shows the metric mechanism is SUFFICIENT to fake sharpness here; it does NOT prove no ability is ever genuinely emergent -- Du et al. 2024 argue downstream abilities track a genuine pretraining-loss threshold. What FAILS is 'benchmark sharpness proves a discontinuity', not all emergence.

entries.claim: Metcalfe's Law: the value of a communications network scales as n^2 (the number of possible pairwise connections)
entries.source: Metcalfe's Law (folklore/Gilder 1993); contested by Briscoe, Odlyzko & Tilly (2006), 'Metcalfe's Law is Wrong' (IEEE Spectrum), and Metcalfe (2013) Facebook dat
entries.note: Fitting V ~ n^alpha: the strong n^2 law holds only under the (unrealistic) assumption that every pairwise connection has EQUAL value (alpha=2.00); under realistic rank-declining value (Zipf 1/k) the theoretical prediction is ~n*log(n) (Briscoe-Odlyzko-Tilly 2006). BUT the exponent is empirically UNSETTLED: real user/revenue data from Facebook & Tencent fit n^2 better than n*log(n) (Zhang, Liu & Xu 2015; Van Hove 2016 upholds), and later work even fits a cube law. VERDICT NOT_COMPUTABLE (revised from FAILED, Crucible audit 2026-07-05): our lab shows n^2 is not FORCED by first principles once connection value declines, but n^2 does not fail EMPIRICALLY -- the headline data go the other way, so no clean REPRODUCED/FAILED is warranted.

entries.claim: p-hacking inflates Type I error in the error-statistical (Neyman-Pearson) approach but not in formal/likelihood inference that accounts for the selection

entries.note: First half SOUND (report-min-p over K=5 forks inflates Type I 0.051->0.227 = Sidak 1-.95^5=0.226). But 'a selection-ACCOUNTED likelihood does not inflate' is TAUTOLOGICAL: feed in the correct best-of-K selection distribution and calibration is guaranteed -- FAILED was never possible. Reclassified REPRODUCED->NOT_COMPUTABLE (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): illustrates Rubin's (2026, arXiv:2602.21792) definitional point, does not TEST it. Prior art: Sidak/Bonferroni multiple comparisons.

entries.claim: Berger (2003): conditional-frequentist testing reconciles Fisher/Neyman/Jeffreys - the conditional error probability equals the Bayesian posterior; the naive p-value overstates evidence against H0
entries.source: Berger (2003), Could Fisher, Jeffreys and Neyman Have Agreed on Testing?
entries.note: Berger (2003, Stat. Sci. 18(1)) is faithfully cited, but 'conditional error probability = Bayesian posterior' is Berger's THEOREM -- an algebraic identity of the conditional test. Re-verifying it on data drawn from the same prior just re-derives Bayes' rule; FAILED impossible -> by construction. Also the cited 0.216/0.041 do not match the canonical Berger-Sellke bound (~0.29 at p=.05). Reclassified REPRODUCED->NOT_COMPUTABLE (Crucible audit 2026-07-05).

entries.claim: Dunning & Kruger (1999): the unskilled systematically overestimate their ability - a metacognitive deficit, shown by the quartile plot (bottom quartile +46pp, top -13pp)
entries.source: Kruger & Dunning, J Pers Soc Psychol 77(6), 1999 - Unskilled and Unaware of It
entries.note: A null model with ZERO metacognitive deficit (self-error independent of skill) produces the SHAPE of the canonical quartile plot -- a large positive gap in the bottom quartile falling monotonically to a negative one at the top -- from regression to the mean on a noisy self-estimate plus a UNIFORM better-than-average offset. So the quartile plot does not by itself demonstrate a metacognitive deficit (Gignac & Zajenkowski 2020; Nuhfer et al. 2017; Fix 2022). RECEIPT STATUS, 2026-08-01: NOT_RECOVERED. The original lab id rotated out of the ledger and the entry recorded no parameters. Parameters CAN be fitted to the entry's own three published anchors (self-assessment noise 3.5x the spread of true skill, uniform offset +18 percentile points), and at those values the table matches to 2.1pp -- but fitting two free parameters to three published anchors leaves no degrees of freedom, so that match COULD NOT HAVE FAILED and is not evidence. Settling it would need parameters recovered from a subset of the anchors predicting one the entry never printed; the entry printed only the anchors used. The published magnitudes are therefore neither confirmed nor refuted here. WHAT DOES SURVIVE, because it was fitted to nothing: with the offset at zero the plot is SYMMETRIC (+25.3 / -25.4), so the asymmetry comes from the uniform offset and not from regression to the mean -- a prediction of the null model, and the entry's own explanation, now separated rather than asserted. Receipt: probes/crucible_receipt_rebuild.py.

entries.claim: Miller (1957): random typing (letters + space) reproduces the POWER-LAW FORM of Zipf, but random-typing Zipf is statistically DISTINCT from real language (Ferrer-i-Cancho 2010; Piantadosi 2014) -- so 'Zipf proves nothing linguistic' overclaims.
entries.source: Miller, American Journal of Psychology 70, 1957 - Some effects of intermittent silence
entries.note: Random-typing corpus (443k words): rank-frequency exponent -1.24, an approximate power law - the math reproduces. Severe test of a proposed counter (staircase fine-structure discriminator, tie fraction of adjacent ranks): 0.89 vs 0.48 at ma CORRECTED (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): the prior headline 'Zipf carries no linguistic significance' is refuted by Ferrer-i-Cancho & Elvevag 2010 (random texts do NOT exhibit real Zipf) and Piantadosi 2014; our own staircase discriminator (0.89 vs 0.48) SEPARATES real from random, contradicting that headline. The power-law FORM reproduces; the linguistic-insignificance conclusion does not.

entries.claim: Gilovich, Vallone & Tversky (1985): the basketball hot hand is a cognitive illusion - P(hit | streak of hits) is no higher than P(hit | streak of misses), so streak shooting does not exist
entries.source: Gilovich, Vallone & Tversky, Cognitive Psychology 17, 1985 - The hot hand in basketball: On the misperception of random sequences
entries.note: The canonical method manufactures its own conclusion. An iid shooter with NO hot hand shows P(hit|3H)-P(hit|3M) = -8.09pp under the GVT estimator (n=100 shots, p=0.5, 20,000 sequences, t=-51), and -17.87pp at k=4 -- the streak-selection bias of Miller & Sanjurjo (2018). Two controls, both able to fail: a shooter with a REAL hot hand (p rising 6pp per hit in streak) moves the estimator to +10.65pp, so it does respond to genuine streakiness; and the bias shrinks to -0.71pp at n=1000, so it is finite-sample as claimed rather than an artifact of the simulation. Re-measured 2026-08-01 after the original lab receipt rotated out of the ledger; the figures then published (-7.9pp, -17pp) reproduce. Only n, k and p matter, all principled, so nothing was tuned.

entries.claim: Hong-Page (2004): a randomly selected (diverse) team of problem solvers outperforms the team of individually best solvers under relay search (n=2000, l=12, k=3, group 10)
entries.source: Hong & Page, PNAS 101(46), 2004 - Groups of diverse problem solvers can outperform groups of high-ability problem solvers
entries.note: Reproduced at paper params: random beats best by +1.65 (t=4.1). But the effect is FRAGILE, as critics argued: it shrinks with a narrower heuristic pool (l=6: +0.90) and REVERSES on smoothed landscapes (-0.38, ability wins) -- diversity trumps ability only in the papers specific regime. Cross-ref: the paired STRONG-claim entry (lab b56ae0) rules the general 'random>=best' FAILED in a faithful powered paired model; this REPRODUCED holds only at the paper's specific params and reverses on smoothed landscapes -- the two are consistent, not contradictory.

entries.claim: Brynjolfsson & Hitt (2000): organizational investments have a large influence on the value of IT investments (IT/org-capital complementarity).
entries.source: Beyond Computation: Information Technology, Organizational Transformation and Business Performance (Brynjolfsson & Hitt, 2000)
entries.note: The cited result (Brynjolfsson-Hitt 2000, JEP 14(4): IT/organizational-capital complementarity) is an EMPIRICAL estimate on real firm data. Our model fit logY=a*IT+b*ORG+g*(IT*ORG) with a PLANTED g~0.06 and correlated regressors, then recovered that omitting ORG inflates the IT coefficient (0.21 vs 0.12) -- but that is the textbook omitted-variable-bias identity, guaranteed once you build the interaction term and correlate the inputs. It ILLUSTRATES the mechanism behind their warning; it does NOT replicate their measured complementarity from data. Reclassified REPRODUCED->NOT_COMPUTABLE (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): tautological simulation of our own assumptions.

entries.claim: Toutanova-Chen (2015): a simple observed-features model matches or beats latent-feature (embedding) models on knowledge-base completion
entries.source: Toutanova and Chen (2015)
entries.note: The cited result (Toutanova-Chen 2015, W15-4007: observed/path features match or beat latent embeddings on KB completion) is EMPIRICAL on REAL KBs (FB15k, WN18). Our synthetic reproduction PLANTED the r0->r1 compositional structure that path-features are built to detect, so the observed-beats-latent gap (AUC 0.966 vs 0.749) is guaranteed BY CONSTRUCTION -- it illustrates the mechanism (path features read compositional paths low-rank SVD misses) but is NOT an independent replication of the paper's real-data result. Reclassified REPRODUCED->NOT_COMPUTABLE (Crucible audit 2026-07-05). Faithful next step: Node+LinkFeat vs an embedding model on FB15k-237.

entries.claim: Barato et al. (2009): non-Markovian spreading with heavy-tailed waiting times t^{-1-m} shows anomalous critical exponents (a distinct universality class) at the absorbing transition.
entries.source: Barato and Hinrichsen (2009)
entries.note: Threshold at branching-ratio=1 (survival ~0 for lambda<1, rising for lambda>1, identical for m=0.5 and m=1.5) is textbook Galton-Watson: ultimate survival depends only on the offspring MEAN, not on inter-event timing, so tail-independence of the threshold is BY CONSTRUCTION. The papers non-trivial result -- heavy-tailed non-Markovian return times P(tau)~tau^{-3/2} produce ANOMALOUS critical exponents (a distinct universality class) -- was NOT tested. Reclassified REPRODUCED->NOT_COMPUTABLE (Crucible audit 2026-07-05). Citation corrected: Barato, Bonachela, Fiore, Hinrichsen & Munoz (2009), Phys. Rev. E 79, 041130 (arXiv:0901.0451).
